look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Check a simple, heart-shaped to broadly ovate serrated leaf, then the vine's tendril or fruit cluster opposite a leaf. The strongest tie-breaker against Vitis is the cut stem: Ampelopsis has continuous white pith; confirm this rather than relying on berries alone.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Climbing woody vine, often sprawling through shrubs and trees; inspect a complete shoot rather than isolated foliage.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Simple (not compound), alternate, petiolate, heart-shaped to broadly ovate leaves with toothed margins. Tendrils or inflorescences occur opposite leaves.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small inconspicuous greenish flowers in branched clusters opposite leaves; compare node architecture.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Clusters of small round berries that change color during ripening; berry color alone is unreliable.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Cut a twig to inspect the continuous pale/white pith; compare grape (Vitis) pith and node anatomy.
